caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional figure of a woman mounted on an ornate, red architectural base. The woman is standing upright with her hands clasped together at her waist. She is wearing a voluminous, light beige dress that features several horizontal, red-edged ruffles and blue ribbon details. Her hair is red and styled away from her face. The sculptural base that supports her has an intricate, scroll-like design and is entirely colored in a muted red. The background of the drawing is plain, with a slight border created by a lighter shade of beige. The entire figure, from the woman's head to the bottom tip of the base, appears to be carefully shaded for a three-dimensional effect, with no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Figurehead from "Union"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
